note: Machine-readable, NON-SECRET edge transport/logging policy for the research ingestion routes (in-transit sensitive-data protection). It declares the REQUIRED deployed configuration — HTTPS-forced with HSTS, a minimum TLS version, no request-body logging (in Cloudflare logs or Logpush), and ingestion responses left uncached — so the deployed edge matches the in-code transport policy (apps/web/src/lib/research/transport-policy.ts). scripts/check-research-transport.mjs cross-ties this file to the code policy and validates the fail-closed values; a deploy-time verifier (documented in README.md) confirms the live account settings against it. FAIL CLOSED: any value weaker than declared here fails the guard.

verification.description: In CI the committed policy is validated and cross-tied to the in-code transport policy (fail-closed). At deploy, the live Cloudflare zone/account settings (Always Use HTTPS, minimum TLS version, HSTS, and the absence of request-body logging / body-carrying Logpush jobs on the ingestion routes) are confirmed against this file before promotion; a drift fails the deploy. No live verification runs without account credentials, so CI stays green without them — the same pattern as the post-deploy live smoke test.
